scope: Same pinned native annotation only. Source-state and direct-label voxel coverage; no geometry comparison, precision claim, independent biological validation or registration.

source.rawZarrMissingReason: Original compressed Zarr cache is unavailable locally. The full semantic digest is recomputed from the 73 existing lossless mask assets; the historical compressed-object tree receipt is not freshly reverified.
source.citation: Fiederling et al. 2021; doi:10.1016/j.crmeth.2021.100074; dataset doi:10.17632/4rrggzv5d5.1; BrainGlobe Atlas API.
source.license: CC BY 4.0 original dataset; BrainGlobe AWS distribution CC0

metricDefinitions.stateCoverage: Number of contiguous source annotation-state runs containing at least one selected native z index, divided by 32. Runs are not spinal segments or independent specimens.
metricDefinitions.representedStateVoxelCoverage: For each covered state, sum its exact label plane voxel count times the full state z-run length, divided by the full direct-label source voxel count. Identical source masks repeat within each hash-verified run; no interpolation is used.
metricDefinitions.sampledVoxelCoverage: Sum label voxels on the distinct selected planes only, divided by all direct-label voxels across 1567 native planes. This is sampled budget coverage and is not reconstruction accuracy.
metricDefinitions.labelPresence: A label present in the fixed source but absent from the selected planes is source_present_but_not_sampled, never biologically absent. Parent-only identifiers are excluded from direct voxel denominators.
